source_note: Compiled from IBPS's CRP PO/MT notification pattern as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (Oliveboard, Adda247, PracticeMock, Testbook, BankBazaar, Edutap, Sreedhar's CCE), cross-checked Sep 2026. The classic Prelims split used here (English 30 / Quant 35 / Reasoning 35 = 100) is the pattern most consistently corroborated across sources and is what your reference screenshot uses. A smaller number of Sep 2026 trackers (Adda247, Mahendra's) report a 'revised' CRP PO/MT-XVI split with Reasoning raised to 40 marks and Quant lowered to 30 — this is NOT yet confirmed across the majority of sources and may be conflating Prelims with the confirmed Mains-side revisions (Mains objective questions increased from 145 to 170). Verify against the official IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI notification (ibps.in) before finalising a bank on either split.
exam_pattern_note: IBPS PO Prelims 2026: 100 objective MCQs, 100 marks, 60 minutes total, computer-based (online). Strict INDEPENDENT sectional timing of 20 minutes per section — candidates cannot move between sections or carry over unused time from one section to another. Prelims is purely qualifying: the score itself does not count toward final merit, but candidates must clear both the overall and sectional cut-offs to advance to Mains.
